Photograph of the white-border [[Obi-Wan's Apparition (Revised)]] card published by [[Decipher]]. The linked source retains the whole obtained photograph; its photographer is not identified. The photograph is tightly framed; some outer white edges or corners may lie at or beyond its frame. No missing border has been reconstructed.

== Source ==
* Physical white-border face: [https://i.ebayimg.com/images/g/4pAAAOSwpg9gtJkv/s-l1600.webp complete source photograph].

== Preparation ==
The complete 1200 x 1600-pixel source remains unchanged. Rectangle (0, 0) to (1200, 1600) was extracted with right and bottom coordinates exclusive, resized with Lanczos resampling to 350 x 467 pixels and saved as PNG. Printed words, art, icons and borders were not repainted, recolored or reconstructed. This is a photographic crop, not a facsimile. Photograph and file acquisition dates do not establish first publication.
